topics.answer: I'm Akshay K, an aspiring Network Engineer based in Kollengode, India, currently working toward CCNA (200-301) certification. I focus on routing, switching, VLANs, and IP services in lab-based environments, using Cisco Packet Tracer, GNS3, and Wireshark to build topologies and validate configuration changes.

I'm pursuing a B.Sc. in Computer Science at CMS College of Engineering & Technology, Tamil Nadu, India, expected March 2027, with a current GPA of 7.49/10. Before that, I completed my Higher Secondary Certificate in Computer Science at VMHS Vadavannur, Kerala (83%), and my High School Diploma at RPMHSS Panangattiri, Kerala.
I'm currently working toward the CCNA (200-301) certification, building the underlying skills through hands-on labs in Cisco Packet Tracer and GNS3.

I did a 1-month internship as a Cloud Computing Engineer Intern in Tamil Nadu, India (June-July 2026), where I assisted with daily operations and helped ensure smooth workflow and adherence to company protocols. I haven't had a full-time job yet -- this was an internship.

On network operations specifically, I work with VLANs, 802.1Q trunking, EtherChannel, static routing, and OSPF, plus Spanning Tree Protocol (STP/RSTP/PVST+) to prevent Layer 2 loops, DHCP, and access control lists (ACLs) for secure inter-VLAN connectivity -- all practiced on simulated multi-switch and router topologies aligned with CCNA 200-301 objectives.
I also have support-operations skills: incident triage, ticket documentation, escalation management, change documentation, and structured network troubleshooting.
I speak Malayalam (bilingual/proficient, C2), Tamil (upper intermediate, B2), and English (intermediate, B1).
I'm focused on becoming a Network Engineer, working toward CCNA (200-301) certification and landing internship or entry-level opportunities in network engineering and infrastructure roles.

My technical toolkit centers on Cisco Packet Tracer, GNS3, and Wireshark for building and testing network topologies, plus Docker and Linux for lab environments. On network operations I work with VLANs, trunking, static routing, OSPF, and DHCP. I also bring support-operations skills like incident triage and structured troubleshooting.
I use Java (with OOP principles like encapsulation, inheritance, and polymorphism) mainly to support scripting tasks and small applications, alongside my primary focus on networking.

My main projects are a set of Network Simulation & Troubleshooting Labs (built with GNS3, Cisco Packet Tracer, and Wireshark) and a Student Management System (a Java/OOP console application). Ask me about either by name for details.

My Network Simulation & Troubleshooting Labs project uses GNS3, Cisco Packet Tracer, and Wireshark: I configured and tested VLANs, 802.1Q trunking, and EtherChannel on multi-switch topologies, implemented Spanning Tree Protocol (STP/RSTP/PVST+) to prevent Layer 2 loops, set up static routing, OSPF, and ACLs on router topologies, used Wireshark to capture and diagnose traffic, and built VM/Docker environments to model client-server and containerized scenarios -- all aligned with CCNA 200-301 objectives.

My Student Management System is a Java (OOP) console application: a CRUD system (Add, Remove, Modify, View) for student records, applying encapsulation, inheritance, and polymorphism with input validation and error handling for data integrity.
You can reach me by email at akshaykh1004@gmail.com, connect on LinkedIn at linkedin.com/in/akshay54, or check out my code on GitHub at github.com/Akshay2278.
Glad that helped! Feel free to ask me anything else -- my projects, my skills, or how to get in touch.
